basis: Balances and plan states are as recorded in the Linear credits ledger on 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-06. Not re-verified in any vendor console. Re-check a balance before a paid run that depends on it.
rules: Credits are a temporary subsidy, not permission to raise spending caps.
Cheapest lane that passes QA wins. A free lane (Remotion kit, Lottie, hand-drawn SVG, Playwright capture) beats any paid lane for the same need.
Azure first (MahumTech resource mt-foundary-resource). Other providers are fallbacks or specialist lanes.
ElevenLabs only through governed_elevenlabs.py. Speech only. No voice clone of the owner.
Higgsfield and Runway spend stays frozen until the owner approves it in the current task.
Local AI is off on this PC: no local models, TTS, STT or embedders. Self-hosted models on cloud GPUs are allowed inside the compute caps.
A credit tied to the ABACare identity is for ABACare work only. Personal-capability work and product films use MahumTech Azure.
Do not introduce a provider merely because a key or a startup credit exists for it.
Anything marked draftOnly is research or a rough pass. It is never the delivered picture or voice.
